title: Pyrofishing Helper
description: A Quality of Life Mod for the Plugin Pyrofishing
body:
# **PyroFishing Helper**
**PyroFishing Helper** is a client-side Fabric mod for Minecraft 1.21.1 that enhances your experience on servers running the PyroFishing plugin. It adds a suite of HUD overlays, inventory tools, and smart automation features all designed to streamline your fishing workflow without ever leaving the game.

## **Features**
**Chest Management Panel**
A panel of smart buttons is automatically injected into any chest GUI. Manage your fish storage without ever manually sorting:

Sort Chest ➤ Rearranges fish in the chest by rarity (Bronze → Mythical), left-to-right, top-to-bottom.
Take Bronze+ / Silver+ / Gold+ / Platinum+ / Diamond+ / Mythical ➤ Instantly pull all fish of a chosen rarity tier or higher directly into your inventory.

All buttons respect a configurable cooldown to prevent accidental spam.

## **XP Bar HUD**
Tracks your Fishing XP progress in a clean, draggable bar. Reads XP gain data directly from PyroFishing's action bar messages and calculates your level progress in real time. Includes support for the Sage augment, with per-level multiplier configuration, so the math always stays accurate for your character.


If you play on a PyroFishing server, you know how repetitive the sell loop is.
opening chests, manually moving fish, typing /fish sell, clicking through the GUI. 
**PyroFishing Helper** automates the tedious parts while keeping you fully in control. 
Everything is client-side, fully configurable, and designed to feel natural within the game's existing UI.
